title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-475} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-229 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` exceeds `2^{475}*(319/100)`, and the degree-228 partial sum does not. The next term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-475}`. The section error on `0,1,2,7,8,9` stays strictly below that majorant. No new kappa is claimed. `Q` is not formed. The exact rationals are in the package verifier.
- The immediate predecessor pull request is #4397. The branch also contains the earlier open two-power packages back through #4367. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c25`.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c25`
- [ ] Maintainer replay of the registered package
